title: Singleton heartbeat with exponential polling backoff
description: Prevents duplicate cross-workspace experiment notifications and reduces unchanged long-running job checks from every minute to bounded exponential backoff.
changes: Use one heartbeat scheduler per OpenCode process while all plugin instances share current session activity.
Claim completion and failure notifications atomically across processes before injecting an Agent turn.
Poll each unchanged running job after 1, 2, 4, 8, and subsequent doubled minute intervals, capped at 120 minutes.
Keep ordinary progress snapshots in the Process panel; only completion, failure, semantic checkpoints, or stall alerts may wake the Agent.

rollback.notes: Restore 20260730-001-adaptive-progress if singleton ownership or delayed polling causes regressions.
